description_en: Set to 1 to download your enabled claude.ai skills into ~/.claude/skills/ before the first query and resync every 10 minutes. Applies only in non-interactive mode with the -p flag. Set automatically in Claude Code on the web sessions. Requires claude.ai authentication
description_ja: CLAUDE_CODE_SYNC_SKILLSを1に設定すると、初回クエリ実行前に有効なclaude.aiスキルを~/.claude/skills/にダウンロードし、以降10分ごとに再同期します。
